mapper.select: SELECT cr.CITIZEN_REPORT_ID AS citizenReportId, cr.CATEGORY AS category, cr.DESCRIPTION AS description, cr.EMAIL AS email, cr.STATUS AS status, cr.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, cr.RESOLVED_BY AS resolvedBy, cr.RESOLVED_AT AS resolvedAt, cr.FACILITY_ID AS facilityId, f.NAME AS name, f.FLOOR AS floor, f.ADDRESS AS address, f.ZONE AS zone FROM CITIZEN_REPORTS cr JOIN FACILITIES f ON f.FACILITY_ID = cr.FACILITY_ID WHERE cr.CITIZEN_REPORT_ID = #{reportId} AND f.MANAGERS_ID = #{managerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE CITIZEN_REPORTS cr SET cr.STATUS = #{status}, cr.RESOLVED_BY = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('IN_PROGRESS','RESOLVED') THEN #{managerId} ELSE cr.RESOLVED_BY END, cr.RESOLVED_AT = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'RESOLVED' THEN SYSTIMESTAMP ELSE cr.RESOLVED_AT END WHERE cr.CITIZEN_REPORT_ID = #{id} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FACILITIES f WHERE f.FACILITY_ID = cr.FACILITY_ID AND f.MANAGERS_ID = #{managerId} )
